Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia, i.e.: Low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol greater than 500 mg/dL
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient's LDL cholesterol was 190 mg/dL at age 45, which does not exceed 500 mg/dL.
Patient has a family history of sudden cardiac death in paternal father, but inheritance pattern is not explicitly stated as autosomal dominant.
Patient description does not mention tendon or tuberous xanthomas.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: LDL receptor negative, i.e.: Receptor binding in cultured fibroblasts no more than 20% of normal OR Genotype with 2 previously described, disease-causing alleles
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Genetic testing confirmed a heterozygous LDLR c.1444G>A mutation, not two disease-causing alleles.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Advanced coronary heart disease with relatively poor prognosis, i.e: Angina pectoris History of myocardial infarction Positive exercise tolerance test Atherosclerotic disease in proximal aorta or coronary arteries by ultrasound or angiogram
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has documented history of recurrent severe myocardial infarctions, angina, multivessel coronary artery disease, and impaired left ventricular function.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Renal: No azotemia No significant proteinuria
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient description does not mention azotemia or significant proteinuria.
Patient has type 2 diabetes mellitus diagnosed at age 48.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has a history of angina but no mention of unstable angina.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Left ventricular ejection fraction less than 30%
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has impaired left ventricular function, but exact ejection fraction is not provided.
No evidence of decompensated heart failure in patient description.
No mention of untreated ventricular tachycardia.
No evidence of aortic stenosis in patient description.
Patient has hypercholesterolemia, not another dyslipidemia type.
Mild elevation of hepatic transaminases is noted, but etiology (stain, NAFLD) is unspecified.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: At least 2 weeks since the following: Drugs affecting cholesterol metabolism Plasma exchange LDL apheresis
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No information on timing of last cholesterol-lowering therapy or LDL apheresis.

Recap: Patient does not meet inclusion criteria for homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (LDL <500 mg/dL, heterozygous mutation, no xanthomas) and violates the diabetes exclusion criterion. Left ventricular ejection fraction and hepatobiliary status remain unclear.
